screen.craftteamracing.kart.spring_hint: A double jump: press jump again in the air for the spring's high jump (50 % is the spring's own height), once until the kart lands, 0 to 100 %. Not used in a race.
screen.craftteamracing.kart.gravity_hint: How much slower the kart falls in the air: at 100 % gravity is a little over a third. 0 to 100 % in steps of 10. Not used in a race.
message.craftteamracing.kart.upgrade_add: Upgrade installed. Switch it on with the Wrench.
message.craftteamracing.kart.upgrade_ins: This kart already has that upgrade.

screen.craftteamracing.kart.offroad_hint: Ignores rough terrain: grass, dirt, sand, snow and mud. A race's rules override it.
screen.craftteamracing.kart.bumper_hint: Does no collision damage to entities it bumps into. A race's rules override it.
screen.craftteamracing.kart.locked_hint: Craft it and use it on the kart to unlock this switch.
